thread:
Aisha (sec-eng): quick heads-up: we need a coordinated rotation of the ephemeral runtime rootfs images next week. found a medium CVE chain in one of the base layers; vendor patch available. planning details below.
Ravi (runtime): timeline? is this a full outage or rolling?
Aisha (sec-eng): rolling. canary first, then 10%/30%/60% over a couple hours. aim Tue 2026-04-07 02:00 UTC for canary, full rollout by 06:00 UTC if no regressions.
Jules (sre): pinging oncall windows — that timeline is fine for EMEA morning. we should have fallout playbook ready.
Aisha (sec-eng): agreed. two extra constraints: 1) the build/sign flow must use the KMS HSM-backed key (no local secrets). 2) we need audit-log retention bumped to 180d for registry and KMS logs for the next 90 days.
Lee (platform): RBAC note: build service currently has broad permissions on artifact registry. I will prepare a scoped role `registry-image-signer` that only allows `packages.images.push` and `packages.images.sign`. need @security review before change.
Sarah (devex): can we surface a small checklist for engineers integrating images? want a short doc for teams consuming runtime.
Aisha (sec-eng): yes. checklist items: sign with KMS (cosign), verify signature in admission controller, pin digest in deploy manifests, fallback image variant flagged `fallback-stable` that bypasses newest artifact if health checks fail.
kms-bot: KMS key `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/runtime/cryptoKeys/signing` audit logs enabled. Forwarding to `projects/redwood/logSinks/secure-audit`.
Ravi (runtime): admission controller changes: we need to reject unsigned images and allow `fallback-stable` via annotation `redwood.io/allow-fallback=true`. I'll open a PR for the webhook change.
Aisha (sec-eng): vuln triage summary: CVE-2026-XXXX (libfoo) — severity MEDIUM, exploit requires local container access. vendor patch removes vulnerable code path. risk to us: image builders that include optional libfoo plugin. patch is safe.
Jules (sre): incident response hook: if canary fails 5/5 consecutive health checks across 2 nodes, automation should rollback to `fallback-stable` and page SRE. I'll add the monitor.
deploy-bot: deploy-check: canary config diff detected: `rootfs:v2.3.1` -> `rootfs:v2.3.2`  (no secrets changed). CI: ✅ unit tests, ❌ integ tests (flaky timeout).
Aisha (sec-eng): we can't proceed if integ tests fail. Ravi, can you triage the integ failures today?
Ravi (runtime): will reproduce locally, prioritizing the tests that read `/proc/fs` — might be a kernel compat issue with the new base.
Lee (platform): RBAC change plan: I'll create a KMS IAM binding patch for service account `ci-image-builder@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` with `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner` limited to the signing key. Also will prepare a narrow artifact registry role. Sharing PR in #eng-security later today.
Sarah (devex): I'll draft the short consumer checklist and a small slack template to notify product teams about the rotation window.
Aisha (sec-eng): final action items: 1) Lee -> RBAC + KMS IAM PR (due EOD today). 2) Ravi -> fix integ tests or provide rollback plan (by EOD). 3) Jules -> monitor + pager rule (before rollout). 4) Sarah -> consumer checklist + team notice. 5) Ops -> ensure log sink retention bumped to 180d (ticket created). I'll post the full playbook once Lee's PR lands.
Ravi (runtime): noted. creating a debug run and will post logs here.
Jules (sre): adding runbook entry: `runtime-rootfs-rotation` with steps: canary deploy -> 30m watch -> rollback on 5/5 unhealthy -> contact list.
Aisha (sec-eng): thanks all. if anyone finds additional images that include libfoo plugin, tag them with `needs-rebuild` and I'll coordinate rebuild priority. :thumbsup:
Lee (platform): PR: https://git.internal/redwood/platform/PR/8347 (RBAC + KMS bindings)
Aisha (sec-eng): received. will review now.
Ravi (runtime): attaching local repro snippet:
```bash
# repro: launch test container with /proc mount
docker run --rm -v /proc:/hostproc:ro redwood/runtime-test:v2.3.2 pytest tests/integration/test_fs.py::test_proc_access -q
```
Aisha (sec-eng): nice. keep updates in thread. planning follow-up sync Wed morning if EOD items not all closed.
